Where we customize

Built around how you actually work.

Custom Approval Workflows

Multi-level, delegated, conditional or matrix approvals — mirror your org chart exactly.

Bespoke Forms

Dynamic forms for anything from field surveys to grievance intake.

Payroll Rules

State-specific taxation, custom shift premiums, industry-specific pay heads.

Attendance Policies

Overnight shifts, split shifts, compensatory offs — configured to your reality.

Employee Lifecycle Automation

Trigger onboarding, transfers or offboarding based on your unique triggers.

Integrations

Connect legacy ERPs, accounting systems, LMS, and internal tools securely.

Custom Dashboards

Role-specific dashboards for CEOs, plant heads, HR ops, and finance.

Department Logic

Different rules per department, plant, brand, or subsidiary — all in one system.

AI & Automation

Automated regularization, anomaly detection, predictive attrition alerts.
